：纵马出行，蛮人踪迹（：纵马出行，蛮人踪迹（第22页）众人一路边走边停，沿路搜寻踪迹，走出数十里。五十里外，潼谷关的火光遥遥可见。陆川换位设想，这群蛮人闯进大靖地界，必定掳走本地村民引路藏身。倘若自己是逃窜蛮人，该择何处藏身。他凭着对周遭地貌的记忆逐一排查，心中先掠过乱石峡谷，谷内遍布乱石，石洞繁多，隘口狭窄，便于躲藏放哨。再是黑水涧废弃炭窑，窑屋依溪水搭建，暗道互通，遇险能顺水道脱身。最后便是断背山旧匪寨，孤悬山腰，只一条小路通行。残墙可作屏障，登高便能远望山下动向，三处皆是绝佳隐匿之处。但若论本地人心底最熟稔的藏身之处，必然是黑水涧那片废弃窑屋。想到这里，陆川不再迟疑，吹响哨声，召集所有队员汇合。等候片刻，所有人尽数聚拢。王茂山迫不及待开口：“队长，可是发现踪迹了？”陆川颔首，看向一众属下：“我已有推测，随我走。”话音落，陆川翻身上马，一马当先引路，其余士卒快步紧随在后。陆川看着身后众人全数步行，唯独自己骑马，略一思索开口：“崔璟。你本是本地人，应当知晓黑水涧那片废弃砖窑。”崔璟立刻领会他的用意，点头应声：“队长你先行赶过去，我带人随后尽快跟上。”陆川见他明白安排，颔首对其余人吩咐：“剩下的人全部听从崔璟调度。他虽出身书生，但饱读兵书，通晓布阵之道，凡事量力而行，局势不妙，切勿死拼硬搏。”陆川不再耽搁，驱白玉驹直奔废弃砖窑而去。此地相隔二十余里，骑马前行，一刻钟左右便能抵达。陆川策马离去后，崔璟望向剩下众人开口：“我清楚诸位都觉得我只是一介书生，胆子也不大，还望大家看在陆队长的份上，今夜行动多多配合我。”王茂山与陈老实同屋起居，自然毫无异议。剩下队员彼此对视，也都默认听从安排。而此时，废弃砖窑内。四五名身形魁梧的蛮人围坐在篝火旁，两名锦衣男女被绳索捆缚在地。被捆的青年高声喊道：“大人，此处极为隐蔽，求您放了我们，我们绝不敢出卖诸位！”领头蛮人把一根柴火丢进火堆，转头扫了青年一眼开口：“等我们安稳脱身，自会放了你们二人。可一旦有人寻来，便先拿你们开刀泄愤。”坐在他身侧另一名蛮人听见这话，压低声音开口：“蛮宗大哥，到时候咱们真放了他俩？”被唤作蛮宗的领头人斜睨他一眼，语气不善：“自然放。”余下三名蛮人齐齐发出一声嗤笑。蛮宗沉声叮嘱众人：“我闯关时身负重伤，伤势不轻，一旦生出变故，我未必能全力出手。寻常炼皮境武人我尚且不惧，可若是遇上炼肉境武人，你们各自寻路逃命。”众人低声应下。就在这时，一名蛮人忽有察觉，俯身贴地细听地面动静。片刻后，他神色沉下，转头对蛮宗开口：“大哥，有马蹄声，正往这边过来。”

Chapter 47: Barbarians traveling on horseback (page 1)
: Traveling on horseback, traces of barbarians (: Traveling on horseback, traces of barbarians (page 22)) Everyone stopped and searched for traces along the road for dozens of miles. Fifty miles away, the fire of Tonggu Pass could be seen in the distance. Lu Lu Lu Sichuan imagined that when these barbarians broke into the territory of Dajing, they would kidnap local villagers and hide them. If he was a fleeing barbarian, he would choose where to hide. After passing through the rocky canyon, there are many rocks in the valley, and the passes are narrow, which is convenient for hiding and guarding. The kiln houses are built along the stream and are connected by secret passages. Finally, you can escape by the waterway. The old bandit village on Brokeback Mountain is isolated on the mountainside. There is only one path leading to it. The remaining wall can be used as a barrier. Once you climb up, you can see what's going on down the mountain. All three places are excellent hiding places, but among the locals, this is the most familiar hiding place. But it was the abandoned kiln house in Heishui Stream. Thinking of this, Lu Chuan no longer hesitated, blew the whistle, and called all the team members to gather. Wang Maoshan couldn't wait to say: "Captain, have you found a trace?" Lu Chuan nodded and looked at his subordinates: "I have already made a guess. Follow me." After saying this, Lu Chuan got on his horse and led the way, and the other soldiers followed quickly. Everyone was on foot, but he was the only one on horseback. He thought for a moment and said, "Cui Jing. You are a local and you should know about the abandoned brick kiln in Heishui Stream." Cui Jing immediately understood his intention and nodded in response: "Captain, you are Rush over first, and I will follow him as soon as possible." Seeing that he understood the arrangement, Lu Chuan nodded and told the others: "The rest of them will all follow Cui Jing's orders. He said, do everything according to your ability. If the situation is not good, don't fight hard." Lu Chuan didn't waste any more time and drove the white jade horse straight to the abandoned brick kiln. This place is more than twenty miles away. It can be reached in about a quarter of an hour by riding a horse. After Lu Chuan rode away, Cui Jing looked at the remaining people and said: "I know that you all think that I am just a scholar and not very courageous. I hope that for the sake of Captain Lu, you will cooperate with me tonight." Wang Maoshan and Chen Laoshi lived in the same room, so they naturally had no objections. The remaining team members looked at each other and acquiesced to the arrangement. At this time, four or five burly barbarians were sitting around the campfire, and the two men and women in brocade clothes were tied to the ground. The tied young man shouted: "Sir, please let us go, we will never betray you!" The leading barbarian threw a piece of firewood into the fire and swept it away. The young man glanced at him and said, "When we get away safely, we will let you two go. But if someone comes, we will kill you first to vent our anger." Another barbarian sitting next to him heard this and lowered his voice and said: "Brother Barbarian Sect, will we really let them go then?" The leader of the barbarian sect looked sideways at him and said in a bad tone: "Of course." The remaining three barbarians sneered in unison. Person: "I was seriously injured when I broke through the barrier. The injury is not serious. Once something unexpected happens, I may not be able to take action with all my strength. I am not afraid of ordinary skin-refining realm warriors, but if you encounter a meat-refining realm warrior, you will each find a way to escape." Everyone agreed in a low voice. At this moment, a barbarian suddenly noticed and leaned down to listen to the movement on the ground. After a moment, his expression darkened and he turned to the Barbarian Sect: "Brother, there is the sound of horse hooves coming this way."
